input.content: Retry-with-edited-values dropped by status gate (P1 pattern): recovery flows that skip re-applying once a record is "applied" (or that apply the record's originally stored values instead of the latest submitted ones) violate "retry with same ID and edited values; success means latest values are active". When the provider write is an idempotent replace, the status gate is unnecessary: for any non-completed record, overwrite stored values with the latest submission and re-apply; only completed records short-circuit to returning their receipt (without re-writing the receipt). Tests that only retry with identical values cannot catch this. Seen in service.py save recovery update (2026-10-11).
